title: The bird on the roof rack
logline: The Legacy in Gully's lot in September, the bird on its roof rack, and through the windshield the back of a man's head at the wheel not going anywhere. The pup's nose at the rear window.

panels.composition: A faded green station wagon in a gravel lot with the small rainbow bird on its roof rack, the back of a graying man's head at the wheel seen through the windshield, a small dog's nose at the rear glass.
